name: accordions
title: Accordions
description: Native disclosure components for grouping optional or secondary information in application interfaces.
useWhen: Users need to scan multiple short topics before expanding the detail they need.
The page can keep secondary explanations collapsed without hiding required actions.
avoidWhen: Users must compare the full content of every section at the same time.
Critical instructions or validation errors must remain visible.
responsiveBehavior: Each disclosure remains full width and keyboard accessible at every viewport. The compact variant reduces visual density without changing the tap target structure.
accessibility: Uses native details and summary elements so keyboard users can toggle each section without custom JavaScript.
Keep each summary label specific enough to describe the content that becomes visible.
Do not place interactive controls inside a summary element.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Bordered FAQ-style disclosure rows with a chevron that rotates when the native details element opens.
accessibility: Native summary receives keyboard focus.
Chevron is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: The base disclosure rows with Tailwind dark-mode color utilities for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Native summary receives keyboard focus.
Dark foreground and border colors preserve readable contrast.

variants.title: Base with Category Icons
variants.description: Disclosure rows with an identifying icon for each content category and a trailing open-state indicator.
accessibility: Category icons are decorative when the summary text already identifies the topic.
Native summary receives keyboard focus.

variants.title: Base with Category Icons (Dark)
variants.description: The category-icon disclosure layout with dark-mode Tailwind utilities for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Category icons are decorative when the summary text already identifies the topic.
Dark foreground and border colors preserve readable contrast.

variants.title: Base with Dividers
variants.description: A minimal accordion that uses horizontal dividers rather than individual card borders.
accessibility: Native summary receives keyboard focus.
Divider styling does not communicate the open state by itself.

variants.title: Base with Dividers (Dark)
variants.description: The divider-based accordion with dark-mode Tailwind utilities for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Native summary receives keyboard focus.
Dark dividers retain visual separation without relying on color for state.

variants.title: Base Nested
variants.description: A hierarchical accordion for a parent topic with related nested disclosures beneath it.
accessibility: Nested summaries retain their own native disclosure semantics.
Use nesting sparingly so keyboard navigation and information hierarchy remain understandable.

variants.title: Base Nested (Dark)
variants.description: The hierarchical nested disclosure layout with dark-mode Tailwind utilities.
accessibility: Nested summaries retain their own native disclosure semantics.
Use nesting sparingly so keyboard navigation and information hierarchy remain understandable.

variants.title: Base Compact
variants.description: A lower-density accordion for constrained settings panels and short supporting content.
accessibility: Native summary receives keyboard focus.
Keep the compact summary height comfortably usable for pointer and touch input.

variants.title: Base Compact (Dark)
variants.description: The compact disclosure layout with dark-mode Tailwind utilities for dense dark interfaces.
accessibility: Native summary receives keyboard focus.
Dark foreground and border colors preserve readable contrast.
